title: RentGuard Late Charges and the Size of the Overdue Installment
content:
**Training note: how installment size bears on a RentGuard Renters Policy late charge**

The rule: late charge addition for installment size — the unpaid part of the overdue installment is its billed amount plus the installment service charge billed with that same installment; when that unpaid part is 50.00 USD or more, 1.00 USD is added to the base of the late charge; when it is 20.00 USD or more but below 50.00 USD, 0.50 USD is added; when it is below 20.00 USD, nothing is added.

**What is the unpaid part of the overdue installment?**
The billed amount of that installment on the premium account, together with the installment service charge billed with the same installment (same term, same installment number). Where no service charge was billed with it, the unpaid part is the billed amount alone.

**What does each size band add?**

| Unpaid part of the overdue installment | Added to the base |
|---|---|
| 50.00 USD or more | 1.00 USD |
| 20.00 USD or more, below 50.00 USD | 0.50 USD |
| Below 20.00 USD | Nothing |

**Where are the edges?**
An unpaid part of exactly 50.00 USD adds 1.00 USD; 49.99 USD adds 0.50 USD. Exactly 20.00 USD adds 0.50 USD; 19.99 USD adds nothing.

**Hypothetical example.** An installment billed at 48.00 USD with a 3.00 USD installment service charge billed with it has an unpaid part of 51.00 USD, so 1.00 USD is added. The same installment with no service charge (48.00 USD) adds 0.50 USD.
